walk.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Image1 is the EXISTING walking sprite sheet to edit. Image2 is immutable IDLE color, head-detail and body-proportion reference. Repair Image1 with MINIMAL edits, preserve the exact character design, facial features, ALL20 walk poses, frame order and row camera angles. No running poses and no new character.
MAIN EDIT: the walking hair is too LIGHT and warm brown. Match the BLACK hair of Image2 exactly: dark neutral charcoal black, median hair near RGB44,43,41, same shadows and subtle fine tuft highlights/contrast as Image2. No brown tint, silver streaks, glossy or pale highlights, over-detailed hair, blurred textures. Preserve exact existing hair shapes.
Match Image2's skin and clothing colors/shadow contrast too, without lightening skin or shirt. Dark muted olive shirt, warm natural skin, ochre scarf, cream cuffs, brown boots. No global color tint.
SIZE EDIT: rows2 and4 (diagonals front-right and back-right) are too big. Correct their whole character size and head/body proportions to match Image2 and the cardinal row sizes. No giant head or thicker torso. Reference overall height remains consistent from row to row. Keep rows1,3,5 at their current overall size. No frame-to-frame size changes.
EXACT layout4columns FIVErows. Rows right-side profile, front-right, front, back-right, back. Keep cell spacing and positions. No new motion, no altered limbs or eyes, no extra arms or hands, no invented poses. Full sprites and existing transparent gutters. Real transparent background, no text/grid/shadows. This is a color/detail/diagonal-size correction of finished sprites, not a redraw of their animations.
